tools.name: validate_jsonld
tools.description: Validate JSON-LD structured data against the Schema.org vocabulary. Accepts raw JSON-LD or an HTML snippet/page containing <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks (pass the text, not a URL: this tool never fetches anything). Returns valid true/false, error/warning/info counts, the Schema.org type

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "validate_jsonld" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_jsonld · Public sink: validate_jsonld.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_jsonld · Public sink: validate_jsonld

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
